slide2.headline: Strong Earnings, Industrials Drive the Book
read_through: Breadth: 42 of 53 rated holdings (79.2%) delivered Good/Excellent Q1 FY27 results; 10 Average and 1 Weak.
Strength areas: power equipment and engineering, pharma, specialty chemicals and materials, auto components, wealth management.
Notable performers: Kernex Microsystems, Marksans Pharma, Wockhardt, Navin Fluorine, TD Power Systems and Thangamayil.
Kernex Microsystems: revenue ₹504cr vs ₹56cr YoY on the Kavach execution ramp.
Concentration: HBL Engineering (8.78%), Cemindia (7.33%), TD Power (6.77%), Time Technoplast (6.46%) and Garware Hi-Tech (6.14%) lead the book.
Pressure points: HBL (PAT -25%), Cummins (margins), IGL (PAT -44.4%), Hind Rectifiers, Axiscades and Astra Microwave.
One Weak result: IndiGo swung to a ₹238cr loss on fuel costs and West Asia disruption.
These pressures look margin- or timing-related rather than thesis-breaking.
slide2.portfolio_implication: Stay with the industrial and pharma compounders that are delivering. Act on the existing CREST views - above all the Sell on Cemindia (7.33%), plus the sizing calls on Nuvama and Edelweiss - and tidy up a tail of 31 holdings below 1% weight.

slide3.title_suffix: Industrials and Pharma Lead the Quarter
slide3.subtitle: Q1 FY27 growth was broad across this small/mid-cap book; misses were margin-led - input costs, gold prices and fuel tied to the West Asia conflict.

cards.heading: Pharma & healthcare
cards.body: Divi's PAT +66% on a ~41% margin; Marksans +170%, Shilpa +114.9%, Viyash +113.5%; Wockhardt turned profitable. Windlas flat; Narayana PAT only +6%.

cards.heading: Jewellery & consumer
cards.body: Thangamayil PAT +84.8% and V2 Retail +68%; Senco revenue +67.4% but PAT -3.8% as margins fell. Balrampur Chini PAT -15.4%.

cards.heading: Banking & financial services
cards.body: MCX PAT +103%, Edelweiss +83%, ABCap +40%, Nuvama +16%; Arman and Equitas swung back to profit. CSB PAT fell QoQ.

cards.heading: Metals, materials & energy
cards.body: Usha Martin PAT +40.6%, Jayaswal Neco +108%, Garware Hi-Tech +60%. IGL PAT -44.4% as margin halved; VOGL turned profitable but faces field depletion.

cards.heading: Engineering, capital goods & autos
cards.body: TD Power PAT +72%, Kernex PAT ₹110cr on Kavach, Technocraft +68.3%, SJS +57%. HBL PAT -25% and Cummins flat on margins; Axiscades and Hind Rectifiers weak.

cards.heading: IT, infrastructure & aviation
cards.body: Redington PAT +77%; IndiGrid PAT +236%; Cemindia order book at a record but PAT only +3%. IndiGo lost ₹238cr on fuel and West Asia.

slide4.subtitle: HBL, TD Power, Garware Hi-Tech and Usha Martin are large positions with large gains; three of the four delivered strong Q1 FY27 earnings.

cards.body: Weakest of the four: PAT -25% YoY as Defence & Aviation batteries dipped - but the ₹1,714cr Kavach order gives 18-24 months of visibility. Current view: Hold.
Revenue and PAT +72% YoY; export-led order inflows; FY27 guidance raised on data-centre and grid demand. Current view: Hold.
PAT +60% YoY to ₹133cr; record 30.3% EBITDA margin; sun-control film capacity progressing. Current view: Hold.
PAT +40.6% YoY to ₹142cr; margin up to 20% from 16% on specialty wire-rope mix. Current view: Hold.

slide4.portfolio_action: 1) Hold TD Power, Garware Hi-Tech and Usha Martin; hold HBL and review after Q2 for margin recovery.  2) Execute the Sell on Cemindia (7.33% wt, +212.03%) - the largest single move, locking in a strong gain.  3) Apply the sizing views: Nuvama down to 2% (now 3.56%), Edelweiss up to 2% (now 0.52%).  4) Review the weakest prints (IndiGo, IGL, Hind Rectifiers, Axiscades, Astra Microwave).

slide5.best: Kernex Microsystems (revenue ₹504cr vs ₹56cr, PAT ₹110cr on the Kavach ramp), Marksans Pharma (PAT +170% YoY) and Wockhardt (swung to a ₹107cr profit; Zaynich US FDA-approved).
slide5.weakest: IndiGo (₹238cr loss on fuel and West Asia), IGL (PAT -44.4% as margin halved), Hind Rectifiers (PAT -40.88%) and Axiscades (loss in a transition quarter) - none carries a structurally broken thesis.
slide5.broad_theme: Revenue grew almost everywhere; the misses were margin-driven - input and fuel costs, gold prices in jewellery, and lumpy order execution in defence and engineering. Earnings momentum supports the core holdings.

slide15.our_view: Q1 FY27 supports a constructive stance on this portfolio - 42 of 53 rated holdings (79.2%) delivered Good/Excellent results, led by power equipment, pharma and specialty materials.
slide15.investment_stance: Constructive. The opportunity is at the stock level; discipline on sizing and the existing CREST views matters more than adding new names - Sell on Cemindia, Marksans, Aarti Pharmalabs, Beta Drugs, Balrampur, Senco, Ultramarine and IndiGo; Nuvama to 2%, Edelweiss to 2%.
slide15.key_themes: Power & Grid Equipment · Pharma & CDMO · Specialty Chemicals · Auto Components · Wealth & Capital Markets
slide15.screening_discipline: We favour names with visible earnings upgrades, strong balance sheets, credible order books, sound capital allocation, and valuation that leaves a margin of safety.
